passages.title: GabayIskolar product guide — Getting started
passages.content: GabayIskolar is an independent scholarship preparation prototype for Pasig students. It does not accept official applications or decide who receives a scholarship. Start at Scholarships or Choose a guide, select a guide and cycle, and read its requirements. The Dashboard connects your preparation stages. The built-in CORE College renewal reference covers three document categories using reviewed source references; confirm the complete current requirements with the official office.

passages.title: GabayIskolar product guide — Choosing a guide
passages.content: Use Choose a guide to select the scholarship program and application cycle you want to prepare for. Available guides include published database guides and the reviewed built-in PSCS reference. Changing cycles keeps preparation records separate. Product help works before you choose a guide. Scholarship chat uses approved published sources or the server's registered built-in references, and is unavailable for closed cycles. A sample explicitly marked as a demo cannot supply official chat evidence. Confirm unknown dates with the office.

passages.title: GabayIskolar product guide — Saving checklist progress
passages.content: My checklist lets you track preparation for each requirement. Read a requirement's instructions and sources before changing its preparation status. Checklist progress is stored in this browser and separated by cycle and requirement. If published instructions or source information changes, the item may need another review. Marking an item complete means you prepared it; it does not submit anything or confirm that the scholarship office accepts it. Clearing browser data can remove local progress.

passages.title: GabayIskolar product guide — The three-document focus
passages.content: The built-in guide focuses on Certificate of Registration, Barangay Certificate of Residency, and School ID or any Valid-ID. These are the prototype's three priority document journeys, not a complete official scholarship checklist. Confirm the exact enrollment document and accepted ID wording in your selected cycle's official guidance. A preparation category does not mean every document with a similar name is accepted. Other official requirements still apply; the guide includes a partial-coverage notice.

passages.title: GabayIskolar product guide — Reading and correcting documents
passages.content: Check a document can read text from a small fictional or sample document through Lumen OCR after consent. Supported browser uploads are JPG, PNG, and PDF, up to 4 MiB. Read the extracted text and editable fields beside your original and correct misread or missing values yourself. Automatically read text may contain errors. A successful read is not proof of authenticity, validity, eligibility, or official acceptance. Provider errors show recovery options; a retry sends the document again.

passages.title: GabayIskolar product guide — Understanding document checks
passages.content: The three-document checking tools compare printed details and raise review flags such as Possible mismatch, Check this, and Note. Names, student numbers, addresses, and academic dates can need a closer look. Correct extracted details against your original before relying on a comparison. These are consistency checks, not official verification or a decision that a document is authentic, fake, eligible, approved, or rejected. An enrollment recency flag asks you to check that you used the latest registration document; it is not an official expiry rule.

passages.title: GabayIskolar product guide — Where preparation data is kept
passages.content: Applicants do not need an account. Checklist progress and guide choices stay in this browser. Private draft details are saved on this device until you delete them or clear browser storage; you can export or delete a saved draft. Checked three-document details use session storage per cycle, so they can survive a refresh in the same tab and clear when that tab's session ends. Browser storage is not encrypted by this app. Avoid shared devices or clear your preparation data afterward. There is no cross-device synchronization.

passages.title: GabayIskolar product guide — Lumen and your information
passages.content: Only fictional or sample documents should be sent to Lumen. Lumen OCR keeps a copy visible within the hackathon organization, and its developer interface provides no deletion operation. Read the consent disclosure before uploading. Lumen also stores chat messages, so do not include names, addresses, ID numbers, document contents, or other personal details in a question. The app keeps visible chat and unsent chat drafts only in memory for this visit; that does not remove Lumen's independent copy.

passages.title: GabayIskolar product guide — Product help and scholarship guidance
passages.content: Ask Gabay has two modes. Product help explains the app using this product guide and works without a scholarship selection. Scholarship guide uses approved published sources or reviewed built-in references for the selected cycle, and opens from a requirement's Ask Gabay action. Switch to Scholarship guide for requirements, eligibility rules, deadlines, fees, or accepted-document questions. Answers need matching evidence; missing information remains a notice. Ask in English, Filipino, or Taglish. Each question stands alone: the visible transcript does not imply model memory.

passages.title: GabayIskolar product guide — Continuing to the official application
passages.content: Use the Official step or the official application link in your selected guide to continue outside GabayIskolar. Review the complete current checklist, dates, and instructions at the authorized scholarship office or official portal. GabayIskolar cannot submit an application, approve documents, guarantee acceptance, or decide eligibility. This product guide contains no authoritative scholarship deadline, fee, cutoff, accepted alternative, or complete policy list. Ask Scholarship guide for published cycle evidence and confirm unresolved matters with the office.
